description: Geodetic Monument Viewer is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoBC Branch. View geodetic control monuments of the Province of British Columbia. A geodetic survey monument is a geospatial reference used for positioning within the Province. The term geodetic meaning: concerned with the precise location (latitude, longitude, height) of points and figures on the earth's surface. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher GeoBC Branch. Its tags are BC, control, geodetic, monument, survey. It offers 1 resource(s) in KML. The portal shows 2022-04-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support positioning and survey control studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
